## 5. Featured Engineering Projects (Innovation Pokédex Catalog)

### 5.1 Byakugan Scan (Pokédex #001 — Native macOS Utility)
- **Official Website**: https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud
- **Documentation & Support**: https://byakugan-scan.aritro.cloud/support
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/halcyon-past/byakugan-scan
- **Homebrew Installation**: `brew install --cask halcyon-past/tap/byakugan-scan`
- **Tech Stack**: Swift 6.0, AppKit, SwiftUI, Apple Vision Framework, Apple Neural Engine, macOS 14+, Homebrew Cask
- **Architecture & Highlights**:
  - A 100% offline, open-source (MIT) macOS menu bar utility for instant in-memory screen text OCR (`⌘⇧2`), QR code decoding (`⌘⇧3`), and 13+ barcode symbologies (`⌘⇧4`).
  - Captures selected screen regions directly into `NSPasteboard` RAM as a `CGImage` buffer and executes `VNRecognizeTextRequest` and `VNDetectBarcodesRequest` on the Apple Neural Engine in **under 50ms** with **zero temporary files**, **zero disk I/O**, and **zero network calls**.
  - Includes a 60/120Hz custom AppKit reticle overlay (`SelectionOverlayController`) with 5 anime-inspired color themes, a frosted-glass HUD toast with contextual actions (`Open URL`, `Mail`, `Call`), local searchable scan history, additive clipboard mode, and `byakugan://` deep-link automation for Raycast, Alfred, and macOS Shortcuts.

### 5.2 Quarantine (`quarantine-py`) (Pokédex #002 — Python Open-Source Package)
- **PyPI Package**: https://pypi.org/project/quarantine-py/ (`pip install quarantine-py`)
- **Documentation**: https://quarantine-py.aritro.cloud
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/halcyon-past/quarantine
- **Tech Stack**: Python 3.9+, PyPI, Conda-Forge, AsyncIO, CLI, Dead-Letter Queue, Fault Tolerance, Pytest
- **Architecture & Highlights**:
  - Zero-dependency Python fault-tolerance library that brings Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) resilience to standard loops, iterators (`shield()`), and sync/async functions (`@quarantine`).
  - Atomically isolates failing inputs, stack traces, and local state to `.quarantine/` on disk so long-running ETL and LLM batch pipelines never crash mid-flight.
  - Ships with a full CLI (`quarantine stats`, `quarantine retry`, `quarantine debug` into post-mortem `pdb`, `quarantine export`) and configurable circuit breakers (`halt_after`).

### 5.3 Structurify (Pokédex #003 — Cloud AI Pipeline)
- **Live Application**: https://structurify.aritro.cloud
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/halcyon-past/Structurify
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, LangGraph, Google Gemini API, GCP Cloud Run, GCP Pub/Sub, DuckDB, Firestore
- **Architecture & Highlights**:
  - Event-driven B2B SaaS platform that converts messy, unstructured spreadsheets and documents into strict relational SQL schemas.
  - Uses serverless fan-out workers on **Google Cloud Run** orchestrated via **GCP Pub/Sub** and **LangGraph** map-reduce agents with real-time progress streaming.

### 5.4 Luffy Laser Dodge (Pokédex #004 — 3D Computer Vision Web Game)
- **Playable Web Game**: https://onepiece.aritro.cloud/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/halcyon-past/Luffy-Laser-Dodge
- **Tech Stack**: React, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Google MediaPipe WASM, TypeScript, WebGL
- **Architecture & Highlights**:
  - Real-time 3D browser reflex game where players physically dodge Pacifista laser beams using webcam head-pose tracking.
  - Runs 100% client-side at 60 FPS using **Google MediaPipe Face Mesh WASM** and custom procedural bone-rigged animations in **Three.js**.

### 5.5 KrishnaVision / GlideConnect (Pokédex #005 — Published Research & HCI System)
- **Published Paper (IJIRT)**: https://ijirt.org/article?manuscript=180711
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/halcyon-past/Glide-Connect
- **Tech Stack**: Python, MediaPipe, OpenCV, Google Gemini Multimodal API, PyAutoGUI, PyCAW
- **Architecture & Highlights**:
  - Peer-reviewed contactless human-computer interface achieving **97.3% hand-gesture classification accuracy** at **22ms inference latency**.
  - Pairs touchless cursor/OS control with "Krishna", a multimodal voice assistant powered by Google Gemini for real-time screen analysis.

### 5.6 PAWsitive (Pokédex #006 — Hack4Bengal 3.0 Grand Champion)

## 6. OpenWorld Portfolio Architecture (`https://openworld.aritro.cloud`)

Built from scratch using **Next.js 16 (App Router)**, **React 19**, **TypeScript**, and a custom **HTML5 Canvas 2D Game Engine** without external game engines:

1. **Pallet Cloud 2.5D Overworld Engine**:
   - Tile-based collision detection, elevation plateaus, animated water shaders, swaying wild grass encounters, and Painter's algorithm Y-depth sorting at 60 FPS.
   - Full mobile support with a responsive virtual D-Pad/A/B/Start gamepad and URL hash-synced modal navigation (`#pokedex`, `#trainercard`, `#bag`, `#townmap`, `#arcade`, `#gymbattle`, `#recruiter`).
2. **Silicon Gym Boss Battle**:
   - Interactive turn-based GBA battle against **Gym Leader Aritro (Lv. 99)** where recruiters execute engineering moves (*System Design Audit*, *LeetCode Hard Blitz*, *Production Outage Drill*, *Cloud Scale Test*), inspect **8 Earned Gym Badges**, or throw a **Master Ball** to fast-track hiring.
3. **Innovation Pokédex Center & Mega Jumbotron TV**:
   - Dual-screen GBA Pokédex cataloging all 7 flagship projects with neural voiceover synthesis (ElevenLabs + Web Speech API fallback), live deployment links, documentation links, and GitHub repositories.
4. **Poké Mart Tech Stack Requisition (Bag Modal)**:
   - Interactive shopping cart of 30+ categorized skills (Languages, Frameworks, AI & Data, Cloud & DevOps) that lets recruiters assemble a custom role requisition and dispatch it via verified email airmail.
5. **Developer Arcade**:
   - Three built-in playable arcade minigames: **Bug Catcher (Whack-a-Bug)**, **Cloud Stack Runner**, and **Tech Trivia Challenge**.
